verdict_text:
NO

The regex for projection matrices omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 96 tensors (6 per layer × 16) are cast to bfloat16 instead of the 112 required, violating Required result clause 1. The check `== 96` was adjusted to match this incorrect count rather than the specified 112, violating the Required checks clause ("exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16"). The 16 `o_proj` matrices remain float32, which also violates clause 2's dtype layout and will fail the grader's dtype and value comparison. The buffer regex `(?!)` never matches, so nothing is dropped, which is fine; the other checks and the sharding call are otherwise consistent with the spec.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
